source.title: Prompt engineering overview
source.description: Learn when prompt engineering is the right solution, how to iterate on prompts, and where to find Claude prompting techniques and interactive tutorials.

source.title: Prompting best practices
source.description: Comprehensive guide to prompt engineering techniques for Claude's latest models, covering clarity, examples, XML structuring, output formatting, tool use, thinking, and agentic systems.

source.title: Prompting Claude Fable 5
source.description: Behavioral differences and prompting patterns for Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, covering effort, instruction following, long runs, memory, and scaffolding changes.

source.title: Prompting Claude Opus 5
source.description: Behavioral differences and prompting patterns for Claude Opus 5, covering response verbosity, agentic narration, task scoping, subagent delegation, self-correction, and output artifacts when thinking is disabled.

source.title: Prompting Claude Sonnet 5
source.description: Behavioral differences and prompting patterns for Claude Sonnet 5, covering effort, adaptive thinking defaults, tool use, and migration from Claude Sonnet 4.6.

source.title: Agent Skills
source.description: Agent Skills are modular capabilities that extend Claude's functionality. Each Skill packages instructions, metadata, and optional resources (scripts, templates) that Claude uses automatically when relevant.

source.title: Get started with Agent Skills in the API
source.description: Learn how to use Agent Skills to create documents with the Claude API in under 10 minutes, listing Skills, generating presentations, and downloading files.

source.title: Using Agent Skills with the API
source.description: Learn how to use Agent Skills to extend Claude's capabilities through the API, covering the container parameter, custom Skill management, versioning, limits, and best practices.

source.title: Skill authoring best practices
source.description: Learn how to write effective Skills that Claude can discover and use successfully, covering conciseness, degrees of freedom, naming conventions, descriptions, and progressive disclosure patterns.

source.title: Define success criteria and build evaluations
source.description: Define measurable success criteria for your LLM application and build evaluations to test it, from exact match checks to LLM-based grading.

source.title: Reducing latency
source.description: Reduce Claude's response latency by choosing a faster model like Claude Haiku 4.5, trimming prompt and output tokens, and streaming responses.

source.title: Reduce hallucinations
source.description: Minimize hallucinations in Claude's outputs using basic and advanced strategies: allowing uncertainty, grounding responses in direct quotes, and verifying claims with citations.

source.title: Increase output consistency
source.description: Make Claude's outputs more consistent by specifying exact formats, prefilling responses, constraining with examples, grounding answers in retrieval, chaining prompts, and keeping Claude in character.
